rationale: Reviewed global occurrence classification for independent mathDef Wave 2 on inventory 34f61b6c... and unresolved fingerprint 7b69e2fd.... All 659 originally inventoried formulations were scanned, with zero unassigned or ambiguous occurrences; reviewed append-only history reconciles 727 raw candidates to 418 currently unresolved canonical identities and 841 effective missing-reference occurrences. The historical 40-context adjudication, 73-occurrence review, nine high-impact negative matches (187 occurrences), and later full first-batch preparatory typed-draft review are preserved in PRs #14 and #17. Generic versus specialized category/functor and groupoid scope, generic limit/colimit size, and historically fixed seed targets must retain their already applied effective corrections. Reviewed source-meaning defects (quasifinite, submersive, topological ring/module), distinct perfect closure/zero-ring rank qualifications, six candidate-context overlays, a bounded explanatory overlink, three provider-convention partials, and four provisional-source issues remain version-tracked as per-formulation source-review/publication holds, not a reason to misclassify missing identities. The current closed-set compactness FIP formulation expressly requires a nonempty family and the previous empty-family warning is not a current error. The owner authorizes the minimum scoped Phase 2 transition and rapid one-generation source-backed provisional definition research with explicit canonical candidate provenance, comparison against accepted and provisional independent meanings, and no recursive follow-up dependencies before independently freezing a bounded release. This gate certifies only classified-occurrence readiness. It does not certify mathematics or citations, apply source corrections, approve production comparison, promote candidate meanings, authorize site publication, or supersede independent-reconstruction/append-only version constraints.
